description: Plan hardening, cross-model adversarial review, implementation planning, and independent code inspection inspired by Claudex Loop.

defaultPrompt: Help me plan and implement this software change with independent review gates.
Review this implementation plan adversarially and list evidence-backed risks.
Inspect this diff, identify verification gaps, and propose proof commands.
interface.longDescription: A skills-based assistant for careful software delivery: recon, requirements, evidence-backed plan review, proof checks, and independent final inspection. It helps you use the Claudex Loop approach. Running local Claude Code or Codex CLIs still requires your own configured environment; this plugin does not execute those CLIs itself.

name: claudex-loop-assistant
